entry.title: New Clinical Teaching Centre prepares the next generation of NHS clinicians

media:group.media:title: New Clinical Teaching Centre prepares the next generation of NHS clinicians
media:group.media:description:
Discover the University of Nottingham's new Clinical Teaching Centre, an innovative facility designed to help healthcare students develop the skills, confidence and experience needed for clinical practice.
Using realistic simulation, advanced technology and immersive learning experiences, students can practise in a safe and supportive environment before working with patients, helping them build confidence and clinical expertise from the start of their studies.
Designed to support the future of healthcare education, the Clinical Teaching Centre enables students to become confident, capable and digitally enabled healthcare professionals, ready to respond to the evolving needs of the NHS and wider healthcare sector.
Located on the University of Nottingham's award-winning University Park Campus, students benefit from outstanding facilities, inspiring learning spaces and a vibrant community in which to study and develop.
Find out more about studying with the Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences at the University of Nottingham and discover how we're preparing the next generation of healthcare professionals through inspirational teaching and innovative learning experiences. https://bit.ly/ClinicalTeachingCentre

entry.title: MRI Experts React to MRI in Horror Movies

media:group.media:title: MRI Experts React to MRI in Horror Movies

entry.title: MRI Expert Reacts to MRI Horror Movie Scenes

media:group.media:title: MRI Expert Reacts to MRI Horror Movie Scenes
media:group.media:description:
Can an MRI detect something supernatural? Could its magnet really turn everyday objects into dangerous projectiles? And just how much science is hiding behind Hollywood's most dramatic MRI scenes?
Margot Roeth, a PhD student in MR Physics at the University of Nottingham, reacts to some memorable MRI moments from horror films, separating scientific reality from Hollywood fiction.
From supernatural discoveries to dangerously powerful magnets, Margot explores what these scenes get right, what they get very wrong, and what MRI can actually tell us about the human body. The video also looks at how MRI works, why safety around powerful magnets matters, and where the technology could take us next.
Margot's own research uses data from 60,000 MRI scans collected through UK Biobank to investigate fibrosis, the build-up of scar tissue in organs. She is exploring which MRI measurements are affected by fibrotic diseases and whether they could help identify people at greater risk of mortality.
Find out more about the University of Nottingham: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/
Explore more about our MRI research: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/research/research-strengths/future-of-medical-imaging.aspx
What myth or media should our researchers take on next? Tell us in the comments.

entry.title: MealPass: The Easy Way to Eat for Less at UoN!

media:group.media:title: MealPass: The Easy Way to Eat for Less at UoN!
media:group.media:description:
Want to save money on campus food without living on instant noodles? 💸 Meet MealPass - the cashless app built to make campus dining easy, cheap, and rewarding for all UoN students and staff! 🍔☕
Whether you're living in catered halls or self-catering off campus, MealPass has you covered. Watch this quick guide to find out what MealPass is, how it works, and how to unlock daily perks every time you eat between lectures!
🔥 What’s in it for you? • Catered Students: You get a £25 weekly MealPass package to spend on food and drinks across campus (covering breakfast & dinner Mon–Fri, plus 2 weekend meals!) • Self-Catered & Staff: Download the app to tap into exclusive discounts, personalised offers, and daily savings • Skip the Queues: Save precious time during peak lunch rushes and exam seasons - just tap, scan, and grab-and-go • Bi-Monthly Prize Draws: Automatically enter to win prizes every 30 days just by using your app to buy a snack or coffee • Easy Budgeting: Track your spend in one simple, cashless app so you don't blow your student budget in week one
➡️ Find out everything you need to know about MealPass & learn more about food at UoN here: https://bit.ly/wheretoeatoncampus

media:group.media:description:
Ready for a culinary adventure on campus? 🍲☕✨ From quick grab-and-go snacks to vibrant Asian fusion, authentic street food, and fresh, nutritious meals, discover the wide variety of food and drink options available right here at the University of Nottingham!
Whether you’re fuel-building before lectures, studying at Portland Food Court, or grabbing a coffee with friends, our food outlets across University Park, Jubilee, Sutton Bonington, the Medical School, and Nottingham Lakeside Arts have something for every taste and budget.
